subject: Term sculpting & tiered onboarding rebate — renewal negotiation
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacraft.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T09:14:00-08:00
Subject: Term sculpting & tiered onboarding rebate — renewal negotiation

Hi Liam —

Great to pick up the conversation from last week. We ran the numbers with Finance and came back with a compact renewal structure that addresses NovaCraft's throughput needs while preserving rate stability through peak periods. High-level: 

- 12-month renewal (starts Jan 1) with a 15% list discount applied for the committed token band (0-10B tokens)
- 3-month ramp schedule (months 1–3) where overage rates are capped at 125% of committed unit price to avoid sticker shock during onboarding
- One-time onboarding rebate of $75k issued as an invoice credit within 30 days of contract effective date — staged to refund professional services costs you flagged in the SOW
- Surge buffer: temporary burst pool (50k tokens/day) available for the first 90 days, billed only if consumed; usage beyond buffer follows capped overage pricing above

I attached a redline-friendly proposal (renewal_proposal_v2.pdf) and the SOW you asked to align (SOW_draft.docx). Please confirm whether the rebate should be recognized as an AR credit or applied against the first invoice — we can make either work, but procurement often prefers an invoice credit.

Next steps I'd propose: 
1) Procurement review this week (hopeful)
2) Finalize contract redlines and DocuSign envelope (we can pre-populate)
3) Ops kickoff scheduled for the first week of Jan once contract is signed

Would you be available for a 30-min sync tomorrow to walk through the ramp and billing examples?

Thanks,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: renewal_proposal_v2.pdf (proposal, redline-friendly); SOW_draft.docx (onboarding scope)
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacraft.com>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
Cc: Karen Blake <karen.blake@novacraft.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T11:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Term sculpting & tiered onboarding rebate — renewal negotiation

Soojin —

Appreciate the clear options. Quick questions from procurement & engineering: 

- The 15% discount: is that fixed for the 0–10B band only, or can we tier to 18% if we commit to a 15B band? Karen (cc'd) would like a stepped discount table for uplift scenarios.
- Rebate timing: invoice credit is preferred. Can that be split (50% applied to first invoice, 50% as a credit on month 3) to smooth our cashflow?
- For the surge buffer: can you provide a worked example showing how overage would calculate if we exceed both buffer and committed band in a single day? Engineering needs the cost predictability.

I'll also paste the initial procurement checklist below for your counsel: contract term sheet, SOC2 evidence, export control annex, and payment terms (Net30). We can accept DocuSign but need legal to redline the Master Services Agreement first — can you provide a doc with tracked changes?

If you can send the stepped discount table and the overage worked example today I'll run this with legal. Happy to take the 30-min sync — 2pm PT works for me.

Thanks,
Liam O'Connor
Procurement Manager | NovaCraft Labs
liam.oconnor@novacraft.com | +1 (617) 555-0199

On 2026-11-08T09:14:00-08:00 Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Great to pick up the conversation from last week...
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@novacraft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-08T13:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Term sculpting & tiered onboarding rebate — renewal negotiation

Liam — thanks, and appreciated the specifics. Attached is a stepped discount table and a short overage worked example I prepared for Engineering (see table in the PDF). Key clarifications below: 

- Discount tiers: 15% for 0–10B, 17% for 10–15B, 19% for 15–25B. We can increase the floor to 18% for the full 15B band with an escalation clause tied to annualized spend (conditional approval required).
- Rebate split: we can structure the $75k onboarding rebate as 50% applied to the first invoice and 50% applied as a credit in month 3. I'll note this in the SOW language so billing can route it appropriately.
- Overage worked example: if you exceed both buffer and committed band in one day, billing uses the capped overage rate (125% of unit price) for token units beyond the committed band; buffer consumption is free until exhausted. Example attached.

Per your checklist: I attached renewal_proposal_v2.pdf with tracked changes for the Master Services Agreement and SOW_draft.docx. SOC2 and export control artifacts are available via our secure portal — I'll include links in the DocuSign envelope.

Linking HubSpot opportunity RDW-2026-4437 here for your legal to reference: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/4437

Confirming the 2pm PT sync — invite sent.

Best,
Soojin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Attachments: renewal_proposal_v2.pdf (stepped tiers + tracked changes), SOW_draft.docx
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-10T16:03:00-08:00
Subject: RE: Term sculpting & tiered onboarding rebate — renewal negotiation

Team — quick internal note to confirm escalation approvals: Finance is OK to support the 50/50 rebate split and the stepped discount table up to 18% for a 15B commit. Anything above 18% for the 15B band requires a VP approval. If NovaCraft signs before Dec 1 we can also provide a one-time onboarding credit for professional services (additional $12k) to be issued as an invoice credit.

Soojin — flagging that you have explicit conditional approval for 18% on 15B and the $12k digest credit if signed early. I'll prepare the internal approval note for Marissa to include in the deal folder.

-David
VP, Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
